name: MCP reference server: Fetch
description: Reference implementation from modelcontextprotocol/servers (PyPI mcp-server-fetch). Reference/educational, not production-ready per the repository README. Blocks private and metadata IP ranges by default; '--allow-private-ips' disables the guard; DNS rebinding not covered.

provenance.notes: PyPI latest 2026.10.10 uploaded 2026-10-11, license field MIT, requires mcp<2,>=1.29.0 (legacy-era SDK line). Supports version.

README: stdio via uvx/pip/docker; tool annotations readOnlyHint true, destructiveHint false, idempotentHint true, openWorldHint true; SSRF caution and private-address guard. Supports transport and auth none.

Repository README: reference implementations 'not production-ready'; maintained by the MCP steering group; licensing transition MIT to Apache-2.0. trust_level is a t4c research suggestion, not a security approval: trusted_external = maintained by the vendor whose API it fronts or by a named organisation, with publisher identity checked against the official MCP Registry namespace or the vendor's own docs; it does not make returned content trusted (see note, #35).
